description: This file defines the WidgetComponentService class, which manages widget information, resource loading, dynamic component creation, and widget configuration within an Angular application, specifically for the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: WidgetComponentService
classes.description: Service class responsible for managing widget information, resource loading, dynamic component creation, and configuration within the Thingsboard Angular application.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the service, sets up dependencies, and starts the initialization process.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Performs asynchronous setup tasks such as loading widget modules and default widget types.

methods.name: getInstantWidgetInfo
methods.description: Returns widget info from cache or default parameters if not cached.

methods.name: getWidgetInfo
methods.description: Retrieves widget info by full FQN, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: clearWidgetInfo
methods.description: Destroys the widget's dynamic component and removes its info from cache.

methods.name: getWidgetInfoInternal
methods.description: Internal method to fetch widget info, either from cache or by loading from server.

methods.name: loadWidget
methods.description: Loads widget resources, compiles scripts, and creates dynamic components.

methods.name: loadWidgetResources
methods.description: Loads resources and modules for a widget, and compiles its HTML template into a component.

methods.name: registerWidgetSettingsForms
methods.description: Registers widget settings components based on directives.

methods.name: expandSettingComponentMap
methods.description: Maps directives to component types and registers them.

methods.name: createWidgetControllerDescriptor
methods.description: Creates a widget controller descriptor by compiling its script and extracting configuration forms.

methods.name: processWidgetLoadError
methods.description: Handles errors during widget loading, updating fetch queues.

methods.name: resolveWidgetsInfoFetchQueue
methods.description: Resolves or errors out all queued widget info fetch requests for a specific widget.
